scripts.start: cp index.html dist/ && bun build src/main.ts --outdir dist --watch & bunx serve dist
scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts --outdir dist --minify --entry-naming '[dir]/[name]-[hash].[ext]' && cp index.html dist/ && cd dist && JSFILE=$(ls main-*.js | head -1) && sed "s|./main.js|./$JSFILE|" index.html > index.tmp && mv index.tmp index.html
scripts.dev: bun build src/main.ts --outdir dist && cp index.html dist/
